text: Koja rijeka teče pokraj Zagreba?
gloss: Which river flows past Zagreb? — The Sava, along the south of the city.

text: Kako se zove jelo od listova kiselog kupusa zamotanih oko mljevenog mesa i riže?
gloss: What is the dish of sour-cabbage leaves wrapped around minced meat and rice called? — Sarma.

text: Kako se zove mladunče žabe dok još živi u vodi i ima rep?
gloss: What is a young frog with a tail, still living in water, called? — A tadpole (punoglavac); mlađ is fish fry, kukuljica a pupa.

text: Koji plemeniti plin svijetli crvenonarančasto u staklenim cijevima svjetlećih reklama?
gloss: Which noble gas glows red-orange in the glass tubes of illuminated signs? — Neon; other colours come from argon, helium and others, but the classic red-orange glow is neon.

text: Koja od ovih riječi postoji samo u množini?
gloss: Which of these words exists only in the plural? — Vrata (door), a plurale tantum; the others have singulars.

text: Koja je od ovih riječi uvećanica od „kuća”?
gloss: Which of these is the augmentative of "kuća" (house)? — Kućerina (-erina makes a big house); kućica is the diminutive, kućanstvo household, kućni an adjective.

text: Tko je 2018. kao prvi Hrvat osvojio Zlatnu loptu za najboljeg nogometaša svijeta?
gloss: Who in 2018 became the first Croat to win the Ballon d'Or? — Luka Modrić.

text: Koji je geometrijski uzorak glavno obilježje hrvatskog grba i zastave?
gloss: Which geometric pattern is the main feature of the Croatian coat of arms and flag? — The checkerboard (šahovnica).

text: Koliko žica ima klasična gitara?
gloss: How many strings does a classical guitar have? — Six.

text: Koji Shakespeareov junak izgovara riječi „Biti ili ne biti”?
gloss: Which Shakespeare hero says 'To be or not to be'? — Hamlet.

text: Kako se zove genijalni profesor iz poznate crtane serije zagrebačke škole animacije, čiji izumi rješavaju svaki problem?
gloss: What is the genius professor of the famous Zagreb School of Animation series whose inventions solve every problem called? — Professor Baltazar; Melkior and Gašpar are his fellow Magi, as distractors.

text: Kako se zove tražilica čije je ime dalo glagol „guglati”?
gloss: Which search engine's name gave the verb 'guglati' (to google)? — Google.

text: Koji grčki bog mora nosi trozubac?
gloss: Which Greek god of the sea carries a trident? — Poseidon.

text: U kojoj se videoigri kopa i gradi u svijetu od kocki, a od eksplozivnih creepera se bježi?
gloss: In which video game do you dig and build in a world of blocks while fleeing exploding creepers? — Minecraft.

text: Koji je renesansni umjetnik oslikao strop Sikstinske kapele u Vatikanu?
gloss: Which Renaissance artist painted the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel? — Michelangelo.

text: U kojem se moru gotovo ne može potonuti jer je voda iznimno slana?
gloss: In which sea can you hardly sink because the water is so salty? — The Dead Sea.

text: U kojem se istarskom gradu nalazi dobro očuvan rimski amfiteatar, Arena?
gloss: In which Istrian town stands the well-preserved Roman amphitheatre, the Arena? — Pula.

text: Koji je Gutenbergov izum iz 15. stoljeća omogućio brzo umnožavanje knjiga?
gloss: Which invention of Gutenberg's in the 15th century allowed books to be copied quickly? — The printing press (movable type).

text: Koji hrvatski otok daje ime poznatom ovčjem siru, kojem sol i vjetar daju posebnu aromu?
gloss: Which Croatian island gives its name to the famous sheep's cheese flavoured by salt and wind? — Pag (paški sir).

text: Od čega se peče licitarsko srce, crveni ukras kakav se kupuje na hrvatskim sajmovima?
gloss: What is the licitar heart, the red fair ornament, baked from? — Honey dough.

text: Koji se žičani instrument smatra glazbenim simbolom Slavonije?
gloss: Which string instrument is regarded as the musical symbol of Slavonia? — The tamburica.

text: Pasmina bijelih pasa s crnim pjegama, junaka poznatog Disneyjeva crtića, nosi ime po kojoj hrvatskoj pokrajini?
gloss: The white dogs with black spots, heroes of a famous Disney cartoon, are named after which Croatian region? — Dalmatia.

text: Kako se zove škola čarobnjaštva koju pohađa Harry Potter?
gloss: What is the school of wizardry Harry Potter attends? — Hogwarts (so named in the Croatian translation too). Durmstrang and Beauxbatons are rival schools; Narnia is from another series.

text: Koja se od ovih riječi čita jednako s lijeva na desno i zdesna nalijevo?
gloss: Which word reads the same forwards and backwards? — Oko (eye), a palindrome.

text: Hodaš prema sjeveru, pa skreneš pod pravim kutom ulijevo. U kojem sada smjeru ideš?
gloss: You walk north, then turn left at a right angle. Which way are you going now? — West.

text: Prema sastavu riječi „zrakoplov”, što on čini kroz zrak?
gloss: By the way the word zrakoplov (aeroplane) is built, what does it do through the air? — It sails (zrak + plov-).

text: Koje je boje majica koju nosi ukupni predvodnik biciklističke utrke Tour de France?
gloss: What colour is the jersey worn by the overall leader of the Tour de France? — Yellow.

text: Koji je rimski car, rodom iz Dalmacije, dao sagraditi golemu palaču u današnjem Splitu?
gloss: Which Roman emperor, born in Dalmatia, built a huge palace in today's Split? — Diocletian.

text: Koji je hrvatski književnik napisao dramski ciklus o obitelji Glembay?
gloss: Which Croatian writer wrote the drama cycle about the Glembay family? — Miroslav Krleža.

text: U kojem se hrvatskom narječju „što” kaže „ča”?
gloss: In which Croatian dialect is 'what' said 'ča'? — Chakavian.

text: Zagreb je nastao od dvaju srednjovjekovnih naselja na susjednim brežuljcima: Gradeca i kojeg drugog?
gloss: Zagreb grew from two medieval settlements on neighbouring hills: Gradec and which other? — Kaptol.

text: Koji je kemijski simbol zlata?
gloss: What is the chemical symbol for gold? — Au, from Latin aurum.

text: Koja je riječ složena od naziva prvih dvaju slova staroslavenskih pisama, „az” i „buki”?
gloss: Which word is built from the names of the first two letters, 'az' and 'buki'? — Azbuka; alfabet is alpha+beta, abeceda a-b-c-d.

text: Koji je od ovih glagola svršenog vida?
gloss: Which of these verbs is perfective? — Napisati: the prefix na- makes a completed action; pisati, čitati and gledati are imperfective.

text: U rečenici „Ivan čita knjigu” u kojem je padežu riječ „knjigu”?
gloss: In 'Ivan čita knjigu' (Ivan reads a book), in which case is 'knjigu'? — Accusative: it answers 'koga? što?'.

text: Koji se sport sastoji od plivanja, vožnje biciklom i trčanja?
gloss: Which sport consists of swimming, cycling and running? — Triathlon.

text: Koji je američki poduzetnik 1975. s Paulom Allenom osnovao Microsoft?
gloss: Which American entrepreneur founded Microsoft with Paul Allen in 1975? — Bill Gates.

text: Koji je skladatelj napisao glazbu za „Odu radosti”, zbor iz završetka Devete simfonije?
gloss: Which composer wrote the music of the 'Ode to Joy', the chorus ending the Ninth Symphony? — Beethoven.

text: Koji je grad u Dalmatinskoj zagori poznat po viteškoj igri alki, upisanoj na UNESCO-ov popis nematerijalne baštine?
gloss: Which town in the Dalmatian hinterland is known for the knightly game of the alka, on UNESCO's intangible heritage list? — Sinj.

text: Koji je pisac stvorio detektiva Sherlocka Holmesa?
gloss: Which author created the detective Sherlock Holmes? — Arthur Conan Doyle.

text: Tko je režirao filmove „Titanic” i „Avatar”?
gloss: Who directed the films Titanic and Avatar? — James Cameron.

text: Koji je glavni sastojak humusa, namaza s Bliskog istoka?
gloss: What is the main ingredient of hummus, the Middle Eastern spread? — Chickpeas (slanutak).

text: Koji je Vukovarac 1939. dobio Nobelovu nagradu za kemiju?
gloss: Which native of Vukovar won the 1939 Nobel Prize in Chemistry? — Leopold Ružička; Prelog (1975) was born in Sarajevo.

text: Koliko je 15 posto od 60?
gloss: What is 15 per cent of 60? — 9 (6 + 3).

text: Koji plin čini otprilike četiri petine zraka koji udišemo?
gloss: Which gas makes up roughly four fifths of the air we breathe? — Nitrogen (about 78%).

text: U kojem se gradu rijeka Kupa ulijeva u Savu?
gloss: In which town does the Kupa flow into the Sava? — Sisak.

text: Koji je animirani film Dušana Vukotića 1962. dobio Oscara?
gloss: Which animated film by Dušan Vukotić won an Oscar in 1962? — Surogat (Ersatz), the first non-American Oscar-winning animation.

text: Bašćanska ploča, spomenik pisan glagoljicom oko 1100. godine, pronađena je u crkvi na kojem otoku?
gloss: The Baška tablet, a Glagolitic monument from around 1100, was found in a church on which island? — Krk.

text: Tko je projektirao kupolu firentinske katedrale Santa Maria del Fiore, podignutu u 15. stoljeću?
gloss: Who designed the dome of Florence cathedral, built in the 15th century? — Filippo Brunelleschi; Giotto began the campanile.

text: Koji je skladatelj napisao „Ljubav i zloba”, prvu hrvatsku operu, praizvedenu 1846.?
gloss: Which composer wrote 'Love and Malice', the first Croatian opera, premiered in 1846? — Vatroslav Lisinski.
